fips_203.name: ML-KEM (Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism)
fips_203.description: Standardized key encapsulation mechanism designed to secure key agreement over public networks. Directly replaces classic key exchange algorithms like RSA key transport, Diffie-Hellman (DH), and Elliptic Curve Diffie-Hellman (ECDH).

parameters.intended_use: Replacing classic keys with security equivalent to RSA-2048 or ECC P-256. Intended for basic low-overhead security environments.
Standard recommended parameter set for general-purpose encryption. Replaces ECC P-256 or P-384, or RSA-3072, providing a robust balance of performance and security.
High-security requirements. Replaces RSA-4096 or ECC P-521. Recommended for maximum long-term security.

library_usage.python: Use `liboqs` via `liboqs-python` package. Initialize KEM client using OQS: `kem = oqs.KeyEncapsulation('ML-KEM-768')` to generate keys or encapsulate.
library_usage.java: Use `org.bouncycastle.pqc.jcajce.provider.BouncyCastlePQCProvider`. Initialize key generator with standard `KeyPairGenerator.getInstance("ML-KEM", "BCPQC")` and specify `MLKEMParameterSpec.ml_kem_768`.
library_usage.cpp: Use `liboqs` C API or `liboqs-cpp` wrapper. Example: `oqs::KeyEncapsulation kem("ML-KEM-768");` or standard OpenSSL 3.x PQC provider with `EVP_PKEY_keygen` using target curve ID.

fips_204.name: ML-DSA (Module-Lattice-Based Digital Signature Algorithm)
fips_204.description: Primary standard for post-quantum digital signatures. Replaces RSA signing (RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5, RSASSA-PSS) and Elliptic Curve Digital Signature Algorithm (ECDSA/Ed25519).

parameters.intended_use: Recommended standard parameter set for general-purpose digital signatures. Replaces ECDSA P-256/P-384 and RSA-3072.
Maximum security applications. Replaces RSA-4096 and ECDSA P-521.

library_usage.python: Use `liboqs` via `liboqs-python`. Example: `sig = oqs.Signature('ML-DSA-65')` to sign or verify messages.
library_usage.java: Use Bouncy Castle PQC provider. Example: `KeyPairGenerator.getInstance("ML-DSA", "BCPQC")` configured with `MLDSAParameterSpec.ml_dsa_65`.
library_usage.cpp: Use `liboqs` C API or `liboqs-cpp` wrapper: `oqs::Signature sig("ML-DSA-65");` or OpenSSL 3.x PQC provider.

fips_205.name: SLH-DSA (Stateless Hash-Based Digital Signature Algorithm)
fips_205.description: Fallback stateless hash-based digital signature algorithm. It is slower and produces larger signatures than ML-DSA, but relies on standard cryptographic hash functions (SHA-2 or SHAKE) instead of lattice assumptions, acting as a stateless backup.

parameters.intended_use: Alternative signature scheme where lattice security is a concern. Replaces RSA-2048.
Standard recommended stateless hash signature set. Replaces ECDSA P-256.

library_usage.python: Use `liboqs` via `liboqs-python`. Example: `sig = oqs.Signature('sphincs-sha2-128s')` (sphincs matches SLH-DSA standard specifications).
library_usage.java: Use Bouncy Castle PQC provider. Example: `KeyPairGenerator.getInstance("SLH-DSA", "BCPQC")` configured with `SLHDSAParameterSpec.slh_dsa_sha2_128s`.
library_usage.cpp: Use `liboqs` C API or wrapper: `oqs::Signature sig("sphincs-sha2-128s");`.
